title: Form Settings Overview
text:
## Form Settings Overview
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000078795
Important Note: These form settings are only available for Custom Forms . This option does not display for Default Forms.
To reach the Form Settings, click Edit on the preferred custom form:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12169819375/original/xQM3pogCthPnaaTj1fTJZXkMcwtSGmvClA.png?1761871997 | alt: ]
In the Edit view, the Form Settings option is in the top right:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12129558268/original/56ZYL-1IFaH5X6Ge1wc-xtaLYjEsf7gufw.png?1691509472 | alt: ]
This article covers each of these settings and how they function.
Once Edit Form Settings is clicked, a module with three tabs displays:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12090802227/original/sTZD9BmP51IVZKCIO1usab30wNzwQmpZ1A.png?1617304978 | alt: ]

## Submission Settings
Controls what happens after a form is submitted, such as the redirect or the message shown to the user.
Submission Settings

## Email Notifications
Controls the email notifications sent when a form is submitted, including recipients and message content.
Email Notifications

## Developer Settings
Controls advanced options such as the database table the submission posts to and the form's system name.
Developer Settings
